title: Product Data Analyst
requiredSkills: 2-3 years of experience as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst in a product-driven environment.
Strong SQL expertise with hands-on experience in CTEs, Window Functions, query optimization, and complex analytical queries.
Experience working with columnar databases such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar.

Hands-on experience building BI dashboards using Superset, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker (including RBAC configuration), with a strong understanding of product analytics concepts such as funnels, cohorts, retention, engagement, and feature adoption.
Experience working with event analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, CleverTap, or similar.

- Be the primary point of contact for data requests across Product, Marketing, and Business teams, managing priorities and delivering timely insights.
- Write efficient, complex SQL queries on Click House to answer both ad-hoc and recurring business questions.
- Translate ambiguous stakeholder requests into scalable queries, intuitive dashboards, and self-serve analytics.
- Automate reporting and data workflows to improve efficiency and enable self-serve analytics.
- Present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling data-driven decisions.
- Own KPI dashboards that provide an accurate, real-time view of product and business performance.
- Maintain a single source of truth for key product metrics, ensuring consistency, reliability, and accuracy across teams.
- Set up scheduled reports, alerts, and role-based access (RBAC) so the right stakeholders have access to the right data at the right time.
- Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics and measure the impact of new features.
- Perform deep dives into user adoption, engagement, retention, cohorts, and conversion funnels to uncover meaningful insights.
- Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that influence product strategy and improve user experience. The best-fit candidate would have:
- 2-3 years of experience as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst in a product-driven environment.
- Strong SQL expertise with hands-on experience in CTEs, Window Functions, query optimization, and complex analytical queries.
- Experience working with columnar databases such as Click House, Big Query, Redshift, or similar.
- Hands-on experience building BI dashboards using Superset, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker (including RBAC configuration), with a strong understanding of product analytics concepts such as funnels, cohorts, retention, engagement, and feature adoption.
- Experience working with event analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Clever Tap, or similar.
- Experience automating recurring reports and building scalable data workflows.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions through clear, data-driven storytelling.
- A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with a passion for solving product problems through data.

- Willingness to stay updated with current exam guidelines and clinical developments
